sources.title: RFC 6960: Online Certificate Status Protocol
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: TLS憑證壓縮：協商、長度宣告與解壓上限
related.titleEn: TLS certificate compression: negotiation and decompression bounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：300與50秒均有雙重限制推導，unknown與無授權簽章不因時間新鮮而通過。 交付ocsp-freshness.csv、時鐘偏差負例及狀態決策表；資料不含真實使用者憑證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Derive both 300 and 50 seconds from both constraints. Neither unknown status nor an unauthorized signature becomes acceptable merely because it is recent. Deliver ocsp-freshness.csv, clock-offset counterexamples and the status decision table. The fixtures contain no real user certificates or external certificate lookups.
related.difference: 建立支援演算法、未支援演算法、長度不符及超出本地上限四個封包描述；所有內容採本地生成文字，不下載未知壓縮包。
related.differenceEn: Prepare descriptors for a supported algorithm, unsupported algorithm, length mismatch and local-limit overflow. Use locally generated inert text; never download an unknown compressed payload merely to test decompression behavior.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地課堂政策要求觀測時間不晚於nextUpdate，且thisUpdate年齡不超過900秒；900秒是教學設定，沒有將它宣稱為RFC通用預設。 thisUpdate設為0秒，nextUpdate為1200秒，觀測時刻600秒；將兩條時間限制各自換成相對觀測時刻的剩餘預算。 可用新鮮度餘裕min(1200−600,900−600)=300秒；觀測推進到850秒後餘裕為50秒，仍需先通過身分與簽章檢查。
解壓後須與宣告未壓縮長度一致；本課另設16000位元組資源上限，計算輸出相對輸入的放大率。此上限是實驗選擇，不是RFC固定最大值。 壓縮輸入2400位元組，宣告及實際輸出皆12000位元組；記錄演算法識別、客戶端廣告清單及解壓終止原因。 放大率12000/2400=5倍；維持輸入而輸出改14400位元組時為6倍，兩者都仍低於16000位元組本地上限。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The classroom policy requires observation no later than nextUpdate and thisUpdate age no greater than 900 seconds. That 900-second bound is a selected local policy, not a universal RFC default or evidence that every responder updates at that rate. Set thisUpdate to zero, nextUpdate to 1200 seconds and observation to 600 seconds. Convert the next-update limit and the local maximum-age limit into separate budgets relative to the observation instant. Freshness margin is min(1200−600, 900−600)=300 seconds. Moving observation to 850 leaves 50 seconds. Positive arithmetic does not authorize a response signed by an unrelated responder.

Decompressed size must agree with the declared uncompressed length. The exercise additionally selects a 16000-byte resource limit and measures output-to-input expansion; this local limit is not presented as a fixed RFC maximum. Use a 2400-byte compressed input with both declared and actual output of 12000 bytes. Record algorithm identifier, the client advertisement and termination reason so that negotiation failure cannot be mistaken for decompressor failure. Expansion is 12000/2400=5 times. Holding input size fixed while changing output to 14400 gives 6 times; both remain below the local byte limit, but neither ratio proves the reconstructed certificate is trusted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OPA：未定義回應與應用整合的封閉失敗
related.titleEn: OPA: undefined responses and fail-closed integration contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：300與50秒均有雙重限制推導，unknown與無授權簽章不因時間新鮮而通過。 交付ocsp-freshness.csv、時鐘偏差負例及狀態決策表；資料不含真實使用者憑證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Derive both 300 and 50 seconds from both constraints. Neither unknown status nor an unauthorized signature becomes acceptable merely because it is recent. Deliver ocsp-freshness.csv, clock-offset counterexamples and the status decision table. The fixtures contain no real user certificates or external certificate lookups.
related.difference: 建立10個離線HTTP回應描述，保留狀態碼、JSON內容、查詢路徑及政策修訂；實作只在明確result=true時通過的解析器。
related.differenceEn: Build ten offline HTTP-response descriptors with status code, JSON body, query path and policy revision. Implement a parser that admits only explicit boolean result=true, avoiding language truthiness or assumptions that successful transport implies authorization.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地課堂政策要求觀測時間不晚於nextUpdate，且thisUpdate年齡不超過900秒；900秒是教學設定，沒有將它宣稱為RFC通用預設。 thisUpdate設為0秒，nextUpdate為1200秒，觀測時刻600秒；將兩條時間限制各自換成相對觀測時刻的剩餘預算。 可用新鮮度餘裕min(1200−600,900−600)=300秒；觀測推進到850秒後餘裕為50秒，仍需先通過身分與簽章檢查。
資料API的HTTP成功與授權允許是不同層；缺result、解析錯誤、false及型別錯誤在本地契約一律不授權，但保留各自診斷原因。 10筆中4筆為布林true、3筆false、2筆缺result、1筆字串true；字串即使非空也不當成允許。 正確通過率4/10×100=40%；修正兩個缺result回應為可驗證的布林true後為6/10×100=60%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The classroom policy requires observation no later than nextUpdate and thisUpdate age no greater than 900 seconds. That 900-second bound is a selected local policy, not a universal RFC default or evidence that every responder updates at that rate. Set thisUpdate to zero, nextUpdate to 1200 seconds and observation to 600 seconds. Convert the next-update limit and the local maximum-age limit into separate budgets relative to the observation instant. Freshness margin is min(1200−600, 900−600)=300 seconds. Moving observation to 850 leaves 50 seconds. Positive arithmetic does not authorize a response signed by an unrelated responder.

Successful transport and permission are different layers. Under the local contract, missing result, parse error, false and incorrect type all withhold authorization while retaining distinct diagnostic reasons for operational repair. The ten rows contain four boolean true results, three false results, two absent results and one string containing true. A nonempty string must not gain authority through the host language truthiness rules. Correct admission is 4/10×100=40 percent. Repairing the two absent-result cases into verified boolean true responses yields 6/10×100=60 percent; the malformed string remains rejected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
